view.scene_description: A large warehouse interior with high ceilings and metal shelving units. Rows of pallets stacked with white boxes labeled 'POTT' line the aisle. Red boxes are visible on a nearby pallet. The concrete floor extends into the distance, flanked by industrial racks holding various goods. Lighting fixtures illuminate the space from above.

objects.label: white cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Stacked in multiple layers on wooden pallets, prominently displaying the brand name 'POTT'. Located in the foreground and midground, forming tall rectangular piles. Boxes are uniformly white with black and red branding. Partially occluded by other stacks and pallets. Supported by wooden pallets resting on concrete floor. Adjacent to other product stacks.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Light-colored wooden pallets supporting the stacked boxes. Positioned along the warehouse aisle, extending from foreground to background. Some pallets have yellow protective guards attached. Resting directly on the concrete floor. Visible under and around the box stacks.

objects.label: metal shelving units
objects.observation: High vertical metal racks extending from ceiling to floor, arranged in rows along the warehouse aisles. Constructed of black metal beams and crossbars. Hold various items including boxes and crates. Located in background and midground. Not directly touching the floor but supported by structural columns. Provide storage for inventory.

objects.label: red cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Red boxes with festive designs located on a pallet in the lower-left foreground. Positioned beside the white 'POTT' boxes. Partially occluded by the white boxes. Resting on a wooden pallet. Different color and design compared to surrounding boxes.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, light gray concrete surface covering the entire ground area. Extends from foreground to background, forming the base for pallets and shelves. Shows some minor stains and wear. Reflects overhead lighting. Provides foundation for all objects in the scene.

objects.label: yellow protective guards
objects.observation: Yellow plastic or metal guards attached to the sides of some pallets near the shelving units. Located along the right side of the aisle. Protecting edges of pallets from damage. Attached to pallets, which rest on the concrete floor.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

{"frame_id": "loco-s4-31835", "image_size": [1280, 800], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
